verdict.rationale: The TLD price list API explicitly returns pricing broken out per TLD and per order type (registration, renewal, transfer), and pricing tiers (account/original/retail) are documented, supporting per-TLD separate pricing. However, there is no evidence of a public, human-readable price list on the marketing site showing all three prices side-by-side, nor any explicit statement addressing teaser first-year vs renewal pricing practices. Missing for 10: public consumer-facing price table showing reg/renewal/transfer together, and explicit confirmation there is no teaser-price/renewal-spike pattern.
